# Happy Trails (G4)

Happy Trails is a quiet, older-looking Earth-pony stallion in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. He is recognizable as one of Granny Smith’s Apple-family relatives glimpsed in memories of Ponyville’s early days—not a major character or a confirmed brother of Granny Smith.

[![Happy Trails in a *Friendship Is Magic* show still](https://img3.wikia.nocookie.net/__cb20121231055640/mlp/images/a/ad/UES1_S02E12.png)](https://www.bronies.de/showthread.php?mode=linear&pid=3661292&tid=17117)

_Image credit: Hasbro Studios (*Friendship Is Magic* production). The linked 2014 fan-forum post displays and identifies this show capture._

- **Appearance:** Pale yellow/cream coat, reddish mane and tail, muted green eyes, and a cutie mark of **three horseshoes**.
- **Names:** **“Happy Trails” is a fandom name**, documented as such in the linked 2014 discussion; it is not spoken as his name in the show. **“Old-Timey Racer”** is his later name in Gameloft’s licensed mobile game, where his description invokes the Apple family’s seven-legged race. These are names for the same background design, not a disguise or alter ego. See the [Gameloft character entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Old-Timey_Racer).
- **Speaking:** No verified dialogue or individually credited voice actor.
- **Appearances:** *Family Appreciation Day* (S2E12), *Apple Family Reunion* (S3E8), *Leap of Faith* (S4E20), and *No Second Prances* (S6E6), chiefly in flashbacks; also pictured in IDW *Micro-Series* #6, p. 5. The [G4 stallion catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions) tracks these identifications. His exact kinship to Granny Smith is unspecified.

## Important moments

He has no verified character-driven decisions or speeches; these are his two most recognizable story-context scenes:

1. **An Apple-family pioneer remembered — *Family Appreciation Day* (S2E12).** Granny Smith’s recollections place him among the family tied to Ponyville’s beginnings. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vaSivR8A2x4) — **scene timestamp unavailable**.
2. **Part of the family’s shared history — *Apple Family Reunion* (S3E8).** His appearance in the family’s remembered past makes him identifiable as an older Apple relative across generations. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjQ92RM3RZ0) — **scene timestamp unavailable**.
